name: CVEL Fregat
author: Dave Rowbotham (CVEL)
description: Fregat restartable upper stage with a payload port, as flown on Soyuz and Proton. New approximate visual model by Dave Rowbotham; mass, propellant, thrust and isp are from the CVEL Orbiter add-on (D. Henderson, LGPL). Its attitude thrusters are modelled as RCS.
